candidates.statement: [\[secondmoment\]](#secondmoment){reference-type="ref" reference="secondmoment"} implies that an $\omega(\cdot)$ with heavy tails is more likely to result in finite variance (which is not surprising). It might seem natural to take $\omega(\cdot) = \pi_V(\cdot)$. However, in practice, we are never able to draw from $\pi_V(\cdot)$. (If we could do that, we would not need MCMC.) Moreover, setting $\omega(\cdot)$ to be $\pi_V(\cdot)$ does not always result in a finite variance.
